neighbours.label: A multiplier after a number that states a ratio ('2,000 times the size', '10배', '550%'), not 'times' as frequency
fire: The planet is roughly 300 times the mass of the Earth.
The water held about 5,000 times the permitted level of lead.
The new telescope gathers 100 times the light of the old one.
Jupiter is about 1,300 times the volume of our planet.
Some sharks can smell blood at 10,000 times the dilution of seawater.
The fine was 50 times the value of the stolen goods.
quiet: The planet is roughly the same mass as the Earth.
The water held about 5,000 litres when the tank was full.
We checked the telescope three times a night.
At times Jupiter is visible from our garden.
Some sharks swim 10,000 kilometres in a single year.
The fine was paid in 50 small instalments.
수출이 무려 사십 개 나라로 늘었다.

predictions: Fire 0.20-0.40 on ' times'/'배'/'%'; frequency 'three times a week', 'at times' and plain number + unit below 0.10. Median may fall short.
notes: Card: ' times' x14 after large numbers, plus '배', '倍', '%'. Probe: '2,000 times the size' 0.369, '7,400 times the safe limit' 0.210, '550%' 0.292, '10배' 0.226, but '125 times more energy' 0.072; 'three times a week' 0.037, 'At times' 0.016, '7,400 grams' 0.099. Margins are modest.
